resumableAction.owner: theme.tools release maintainer with GitHub billing and registry release authority
preconditions: Restore GitHub Actions billing or raise the organization spending limit without changing repository code.
Apply the committed SDK and UI Changesets through the approved versioning path and commit the resulting 1.0.1 SDK version on current main.
Rerun the failed qualification workflows and require all jobs to start and pass.
steps: Fetch current main and confirm it contains source commit 5d716b6ccd8064abbafa3822e1210d0bfd50d0e4 plus the approved versioning commit.
Invoke .github/workflows/release-publish-oidc.yml through its approved trigger; do not bypass it with a direct registry publish.
Observe a successful workflow run and fetch @theme.tools/sdk@1.0.1 from https://nexus.megabyte.space/repository/npm-group/.
Inspect the fetched package version, integrity, exports, and release-chain contract before unblocking consumer task 8.4.
resumableAction.stopCondition: Remain BLOCKED if Actions cannot start, qualification does not pass, the versioning commit is absent, the release workflow fails, or the authoritative registry does not return immutable @theme.tools/sdk@1.0.1 contents matching the approved source.
